title: ISSUE_PUNISHMENT command
description: Sent by the web backend on justbans:commands to ban, tempban, warn or kick a player. The plugin answers with a COMMAND_RESULT carrying the same requestId. The schema is deliberately strict (no unknown fields) so typos are caught on the web side; the plugin itself ignores unknown fields.

requestId.description: Idempotency key. Generate one per user action and reuse it when retrying: the command executes at most once, a retry returns the stored result.

name.description: Shown in-game and in history, e.g. "Web: alice".

ref.description: Your panel's user id; stored with the punishment for auditing.

target.description: A player the network has seen before. Prefer uuid; a name is resolved from jb_players and fails with UNKNOWN_PLAYER if unknown or ambiguous.

kind.description: BAN/TEMPBAN with a SERVER or GROUP scope are treated as SERVER_BAN/SERVER_TEMPBAN. TEMPBAN kinds require a finite duration (from `duration` or the reason's default).

scope.description: Where the ban applies. Omit for the whole network. Required for SERVER_BAN and SERVER_TEMPBAN.

target.description: Server id or group name; ignored for NETWORK.

reasonId.description: A reason id from reasons.yml (jb_reasons). Wins over customReason when both are given.

customReason.description: Free text, used when no reasonId is given. Longer text is truncated.

duration.description: e.g. 30d, 1d12h, 90m, perm (lower case). Omit to use the reason's default duration. Maximum 10 years.

silent.description: Do not broadcast to players (staff are still alerted).

note.description: Internal staff note, never shown to the player or put in events.

force.description: Replace an existing active ban in the same scope instead of failing with ALREADY_BANNED. It does not bypass exemptions: players holding justbans.exempt still answer TARGET_EXEMPT.
